identity_boundary.automation_rule: Automation identities are separate actors and never impersonate or inherit a partner session.
identity_boundary.tenant_rule: The server derives one immutable tenant context from the verified session, actor assignment, and resource mapping; client tenant input is never authoritative.
identity_boundary.launch_tenant: exactly one CARR tenant with Joe and Dell only
identity_boundary.cross_tenant_rule: default deny before existence or metadata disclosure, with privacy-safe nonexistent parity

identity_dimensions.organization_tenant_id: immutable server-derived organization boundary; never selected by a browser, model, job, personal rule, or connector input
identity_dimensions.sponsoring_human_id_and_partner_id: immutable server-validated human sponsorship used only to select the matching partner brain and to preserve human sponsorship in audit
identity_dimensions.agent_principal_id_and_runtime_principal: immutable executor identity used for attribution and agent capability evaluation; Codex and Claude remain the actor even when Joe or Dell sponsors the session
identity_dimensions.session_capability_profile: server-issued exact task/session capability allow-list with expiry; sponsorship and personal rules cannot widen it
identity_dimensions.personal_brain_scope: server-resolved Joe-personal, Dell-personal, or none; it neither chooses tenant nor grants capabilities
identity_dimensions.personal_brain_version_and_counts: resolved source version plus shared and personal rule counts; bodies are excluded from audit

personal_rule_resolution.joe_sponsored: Codex or Claude loads shared plus Joe-personal; current evidence is 144 shared plus 30 Joe-personal. A Local Edge Node may be a bounded service but cannot select sponsor, tenant, personal brain, or capability.
personal_rule_resolution.dell_sponsored: Codex or Claude loads shared plus the fresh resolved Dell-personal artifact; a declared zero is valid only when scope and source version resolved successfully.
personal_rule_resolution.unsponsored_background: Shared rules and/or server-attached task-scoped rules are the only rule sources, with personal brain scope none and personal count zero; no human sponsor claim, partner brain, partner cookie, or humanOnly capability.
personal_rule_resolution.cross_brain: deny without returning personal rule bodies or counts
personal_rule_resolution.missing_or_ambiguous: visible failure or Unknown with null personal count; never normalize to successful zero
personal_rule_resolution.connector_fallback_parity: connector/store and generated fallback must resolve the same partner brain, version, and counts

platform_control.dell_launch_role: equal business-record operator inside the CARR tenant; no platform ownership transfer is implied
platform_control.corporate_boundary: customer seat licensee only; no platform, intellectual-property, source, infrastructure, security-policy, or roadmap control

human_seat_workspace_boundary.company_shape: CARR has more than 150 human real estate agents, including solo agents and multi-agent teams.
human_seat_workspace_boundary.human_seat: A verified human CARR seat grants authentication and licensed modules only; it grants no business data by itself.
human_seat_workspace_boundary.business_authority: Every business read or write requires a server-derived active workspace membership, workspace role, module entitlement, resource visibility, purpose, session freshness, and current revocation version.
human_seat_workspace_boundary.panhandle_workspace: Panhandle Team is an isolated workspace whose initial members are Joe and Dell. No other CARR seat, team, administrator, Doc session, Hermes runtime, or corporate search inherits its data.
human_seat_workspace_boundary.solo_and_team_rule: A solo agent receives a private workspace. A real estate team receives a workspace with explicit individual memberships and attribution; shared logins and permission pooling are prohibited.
human_seat_workspace_boundary.tenant_administration: Seat and module administration grants no automatic business-record, search, file, call, memory, integration, export, offline-pack, or workspace access.
human_seat_workspace_boundary.sharing_rule: Cross-workspace sharing or referral is a typed minimum-field object with explicit recipient, purpose, expiry, revocation, and provenance; it does not expose the source workspace.
human_seat_workspace_boundary.rollout_rule: Only Joe and Dell in Panhandle Team are planned to operate the system. Company-scale structure is pre-engineered now to avoid later redesign; no additional CARR-user onboarding, commercialization, public SaaS, or company-wide rollout is authorized.

risk_classes.name: local_capture
